initial_reconstruction.claim: All four assigned recipient-model/tool groups use fewer pooled total tokens under EAL. Inclusive donor-plus-recipient reductions are slightly larger than recipient-only reductions. Plain/no-tools shows the largest displayed reduction; plain/tools the smallest.
quantities: Horizontal position is pooled total-token reduction in percent, with the explicit formula 100(1 - sum EAL / sum ordinary) in the caption. Vertical positions identify four categorical groups; within-group vertical offsets separate roles and carry no numeric meaning.
Blue square means donor plus ten recipients; orange triangle means ten recipients only. All eight displayed marks visibly match the two legend glyphs. Legend scope includes all four assigned groups.
initial_reconstruction.evidence_status: Derived descriptive reductions from paired observed session token accounting. No uncertainty interval is displayed; repeated trajectories do not establish independent sampled cases.
initial_reconstruction.scope: Each assigned recipient-model/tool group has 48 paired trajectories, 528 donor-inclusive sessions per arm and 480 recipient-only sessions per arm. Ordinary token sums are role-specific denominators. Donor-inclusive enabled-tool groups pool both donor models; recipients-only groups use actual recipient model. The scope is not an individual recipient model total when donors are retained.
unintended_inferences: Within these paired observations, pooled token use declines in every shown group. The difference between the two estimators is descriptive and reflects different role-specific denominators. The figure does not establish causal model/tool effects, statistical significance or generalisation to tasks beyond the observed cases.
